description: Uploads a workout file to the user's Suunto account. Provide the absolute path to the file on disk. The file is pushed to Suunto and appears in the app after processing (usually a few seconds). Waits for Suunto to process the file (polling the upload status for up to about 20 s) and returns { uploadId, message, status, check: { verified, note? } }: verified is true when the status reaches 'Processed'; otherwise note says why (another final status such as 'Error', or processing not finished in time — then poll get_upload_status with the uploadId later). Uploads are queued one at a time with a short pause, so several calls at once are safe. Suunto's own upload API docs state only .fit (binary) is currently supported for this endpoint — a .gpx path is still accepted here (sent as application/gpx+xml) in case that changes, but treat it as unverified; use .fit for a workout that must reliably show up. Write operation.

comment.description: Longer notes for the workout. Optional.

description.description: Short workout title shown in the Suunto app. Optional.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the .fit or .gpx file on disk.

privacy.description: Visibility. DEFAULT uses the account's default setting.
